synthesis_headline.heroStatement:
Where semantic steering, witness verification,
and low-latency actuation refuse to collapse
into one untyped plane.
synthesis_headline.leftSpine: S ≠ W ≠ A · FIVE NON-COMMUTATIVE CLOCKS
synthesis_headline.researchQuestionMeta: CONSTITUTIVE INQUIRY QUESTION · S ≠ W ≠ A · UNRATIFIED
synthesis_headline.researchQuestion: “Across thirty-two cybernetic architectures spanning real-time audio clocks, e-textile transduction, and hypervisor control planes, what non-collapsing invariants emerge when semantic steering, witness verification, and low-latency actuation stay strictly typed—and what open horizon remains for human judgment?”
